records.title: Transformer-Based Autonomous Driving Models and Deployment-Oriented Compression: A Survey
records.reason: This survey concerns Transformer-based autonomous-driving models and their deployment compression strategies; its target is vehicle perception/planning systems, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: SynQ: Accurate Zero-shot Quantization by Synthesis-aware Fine-tuning
records.reason: SynQ is a zero-shot quantization method for pretrained neural networks that reports accuracy across general ZSQ comparisons; the abstract does not establish LLM-specific inference/compression evaluation.

records.title: Mnemis: Dual-Route Retrieval on Hierarchical Graphs for Long-Term LLM Memory
records.reason: Mnemis improves long-term LLM memory through hierarchical graph retrieval and evaluates memory/task quality; no inference-time cost or serving improvement is established.

records.title: Quantized but Deceptive? A Multi-Dimensional Truthfulness Evaluation of Quantized LLMs
records.reason: This paper evaluates truthfulness behavior of quantized LLMs; quantization is the experimental condition, while the contribution is a quality/reliability evaluation rather than an efficiency method.

records.title: Implicit Cross-Lingual Rewarding for Efficient Multilingual Preference Alignment
records.reason: The work reduces multilingual preference-data needs through cross-lingual reward transfer and DPO fine-tuning; its reported gains are alignment quality, not inference.
